name: close_drawer
code:
def primitive(obj, target, p):
    has_parts = 'parts' in obj
    has_front = 0
    has_handle = 0
    if has_parts:
        if 'front' in obj['parts']:
            has_front = 1
        if 'handle' in obj['parts']:
            has_handle = 1
    nx = 0.0
    ny = 0.0
    rx = 0.0
    ry = 0.0
    rz = 0.0
    if has_handle == 1:
        part = obj['parts']['handle']
        nx = part['normal'][0]
        ny = part['normal'][1]
        nl = hypot(nx, ny)
        if nl > 0.0001:
            nx = nx / nl
            ny = ny / nl
        if 'tip' in part:
            rx = part['tip'][0]
            ry = part['tip'][1]
            rz = part['tip'][2]
        else:
            rx = part['center'][0]
            ry = part['center'][1]
            rz = part['center'][2]
    else:
        if has_front == 1:
            part2 = obj['parts']['front']
            nx = part2['normal'][0]
            ny = part2['normal'][1]
            nl2 = hypot(nx, ny)
            if nl2 > 0.0001:
                nx = nx / nl2
                ny = ny / nl2
            rx = part2['center'][0]
            ry = part2['center'][1]
            rz = part2['center'][2]
        else:
            cx0 = obj['center'][0]
            cy0 = obj['center'][1]
            d0 = hypot(cx0, cy0)
            if d0 < 0.0001:
                nx = -1.0
                ny = 0.0
            else:
                nx = -cx0 / d0
                ny = -cy0 / d0
            w0 = obj['width']
            rx = cx0 + nx * w0 * 0.5
            ry = cy0 + ny * w0 * 0.5
            rz = obj['top_z'] * 0.5
    yaw = atan2(ny, nx)
    ix = -nx
    iy = -ny
    pz = rz + p['tool_lift']
    if pz < 0.02:
        pz = 0.02
    px = rx + nx * p['contact_gap']
    py = ry + ny * p['contact_gap']
    pre_d = p['pre_dist']
    pre_x = rx + nx * pre_d
    pre_y = ry + ny * pre_d
    pre_z = pz + p['approach_lift']
    if has_handle == 1:
        close_gripper()
    else:
        open_gripper()
    move(pre_x, pre_y, pre_z, yaw=yaw, speed=p['approach_speed'])
    move(px, py, pz, yaw=yaw, speed=p['approach_speed'])
    move_linear(ix, iy, dz=0.0, dist=p['push_dist'], speed=p['push_speed'], until_stall=1, stall_lag=0.012)
description: Align hand x with outward normal for wide stable push, start just outside handle tip or front center, then drive inward with move_linear until stall at the closed end stop.
check: look() shows front/handle displaced inward along -normal and drawer joint <= 0.01 (front flush, no open gap)

pre_dist.meaning: standoff outward along front normal for collision-free approach

contact_gap.meaning: gap outward from handle tip or front center where push starts

tool_lift.meaning: tool point height above part ref z so fingertips overlap front

approach_lift.meaning: height of pre-approach above push height

push_dist.meaning: max inward travel along -normal, stall stops at closed end stop

lineage.description: push an open drawer closed: slide it back in along the front's inward normal (against the outward normal) until it stops
